text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert merged: PDR-87342 fired – multiple signals (gateway-5xx-highrate, kvcache-evict). Affected regions: eu-west1, us-east1. Severity: P2. Auto-page sent to inference-oncall and #incidents.

pagerduty-bot: PD: Incident PDR-87342 created and paged. Escalation policy: inference-oncall. Primary: @maria / Secondary: @ben.

alice: @maria seeing a sudden 5xx spike and lots of 502s in gateway logs — confirmed in Grafana (error_rate > 8%).

maria: Ack — I'm on it. Starting triage. First glance: spike aligns with a canary rollout about 15m ago.

ben: Noted — a small rollout for inference-gateway:v2.14 started ~00:12 ago in eu-west1. Any new kernel params/paging changes?

maria: Pausing canary rollout (traffic -> 0%). Pulling recent gateway traces.

maria: logs snippet: ```
ERROR upstream timeout: 502 from model-worker-3 | kv-warmup failed | trace_id=req-0a1b2c
```

maria: Scaling model-worker pool in eu-west: `kubectl scale deployment model-worker -n inference-eu-west --replicas=8` — doing now.

alice: Quick healthcheck: `curl -I https://eu.gateway.redwood.ai/health` -> 502 still.

ben: I'm applying a soft request-weight cap on non-prem customers to reduce retries: edge-config `--set-request-weight=2`. This should buy us headroom.

sam: Observed lots of KV cache evictions correlated with the spike. Hypothesis: memory pressure on model-worker nodes causing evictions and cold-start churn.

maria: Rolling back the new memory-heavy kernel param from v2.14 on canary hosts. Patch pushed.

pagerduty-bot: PD: Incident acknowledged by maria.

incident-bot: Alert dedupe: multiple PD signals merged into PDR-87342 (debounced duplicate paging).

ben: Can someone grep gateway logs for req-0a1b2c and share trace? Need stack to pinpoint timeout hop.

maria: Trace for req-0a1b2c: `gateway -> kvproxy (evicted) -> worker timed out after 1.2s waiting for KVCACHE warmup` — looks like a warmup/cache pressure issue.

maria: Adjusting redis eviction policy and restarting kvproxy on eu-west nodes: `redis.conf -> maxmemory-policy volatile-lru`, restarting kvproxy service.

sam: After kvproxy restart and scaling, success rate in eu-west jumped from ~84% to ~96% within ~2m.

alice: Customer impact check: only ~3% of total requests are seeing 5xx, mostly from a small set of enterprise accounts (acct-X, acct-Y). CS notified?

ben: Looping CS: @tara can you prep outreach for acct-X and acct-Y with a short heads-up? We'll confirm numbers once stable.

tara: On it. Drafting a 1-paragraph note — will hold until we confirm mitigation is effective.

maria: Plan to re-enable canary only after warming caches and limiting traffic: re-enable at 1% traffic for 10m with pre-warm step. Also keep the memory patch rolled back until we validate.

ben: Also enabling fallback to smaller model instance for latency-sensitive routes as a temporary safeguard.

pagerduty-bot: PD: Escalation timer stopped — no further escalation required at this time.

oncall-sre: Handoff note: in ~25m I'll hand over to @kevin. Please add runbook steps to the incident doc (scale, restart kvproxy, rollback canary flag, notify CS).

maria: Mitigations applied: scaled workers, tuned redis eviction, paused/rolled back canary param, restarted kvproxy, warmed caches. Observability: global success rate now ~99.1%, eu-west stabilized at 99.6%.

ben: Followups: add a pre-warm KV cache step to rollout checklist; improve alert debounce to suppress duplicate PD pages across correlated signals; add a canary memory-pressure gate. Assign to eng-releases and eng-runtime.

maria: Acknowledged. I'll stay monitoring for 30m and then mark resolved if stable.

incident-bot: PD: Incident PDR-87342 mitigated — auto-close scheduled after 45m pending postmortem.

alice: Thanks everyone. Minimal customer impact, mitigations worked. Re-open thread if anything spikes again. :thumbsup: 

ben: Adding action items in the incident doc now. :memo: 

tara: Customer notes drafted and sent to acct-X/acct-Y with status summary.

kevin: I've read the handoff. Will monitor the next 30m and pick up follow-ups.

maria: Closing comment — please review runbook and add a concrete probe for KVCACHE warmup to alert earlier.

incident-bot: Thread archived to incidents channel log.
